medicaid.title: Medicaid hours calculator
medicaid.link_with_date: Medicaid hours calculator: Pennsylvania's rule starts {date}
medicaid.intro: From {start}, many Pennsylvania adults aged 19 to 64 with Medicaid must show {hours} hours in one month of work, volunteering, a work program or school. A monthly income of at least {income} also counts. This page adds up your hours for one month.
medicaid.private: We do not save anything you type here. It stays on your device and is gone when you leave the page.
medicaid.only_dhs: This tool adds up hours. It does not decide whether you keep Medicaid. Only Pennsylvania DHS decides.
medicaid.not_legal: This is not legal advice. For help, call the Pennsylvania Health Law Project at {phlp} or Community Legal Services at {cls}.
medicaid.answer_letters: Always answer letters from DHS by the date in the letter.
medicaid.not_proof: Hours you keep track of on Citywide Volunteers are not official proof. Proof comes from each organization.
medicaid.exempt_heading: Who does not have to do this
medicaid.exempt_intro: These groups do not have to show hours. This list is for information only. Only DHS decides who it applies to.

exempt.age: People under 19 or 65 and older, and anyone with Medicare
exempt.pregnant: People who are pregnant or on postpartum Medicaid
exempt.caregiver: Parents, guardians and caregivers of a child 13 or younger, or of a person with a disability
exempt.frail: People who are medically frail or have special medical needs, such as a disability, a serious medical condition, a disabling mental health condition or a substance use disorder
exempt.treatment: People in a drug or alcohol treatment program
exempt.jail: People in jail or prison, or released in the last few months
exempt.native: American Indian and Alaska Native people
exempt.veteran: Veterans with a 100% VA disability rating
exempt.snap_tanf: People meeting TANF work rules, or SNAP work rules in a SNAP household
exempt.hardship: People with a short-term hardship, such as a stay in a hospital or care facility, or travel for care of a serious condition

medicaid.noscript: The calculator needs JavaScript. The information and the checklist on this page work without it.
medicaid.month_hint: Use numbers from one calendar month. Hours from two different months do not add together.
medicaid.rounding: Hours are rounded down to the nearest 15 minutes, so the total never counts more than you did.
medicaid.income_label: Household income this month, before taxes, in dollars
medicaid.income_hint: Medicaid counts household income. Your caseworker can tell you how DHS counts yours.
medicaid.volunteer_hint: Counts only through an organization that keeps track of your dates and hours. Helping a neighbor on your own, or campaigning for a candidate, does not count.
medicaid.program_hint: For example, a job training program.
medicaid.credits_hint: Each credit hour counts as {per} hours for each week of the month.
medicaid.invalid: Enter a number, like 12 or 12.5. Leave out commas between thousands: 1200, not 1,200.
medicaid.rounded_input: Counted as {time}. Hours are rounded down to the nearest 15 minutes.
medicaid.from_income: From work (income divided by {wage} an hour)
medicaid.reached: This adds up to {hours} hours or more.
medicaid.income_alone: Income of {income} or more in a month counts on its own, with no hours needed. Only DHS decides how your household income is counted.
medicaid.school_alone: School at least half-time counts for the whole month on its own.
medicaid.check_month_renewing: If you already have Medicaid: any one month between your last application or renewal and your next renewal. From 2027, renewals come every 6 months.
medicaid.check_month_applying: If you are applying: the month before the month you apply.

about_page.title: About {site_name}
about_page.lead: {site_name} puts volunteer shifts from across {city} in one free calendar, in English and Spanish.

shifts.heading: Every volunteer shift in one place
shifts.body: Organizations across {city} post volunteer shifts on their own websites. We gather them into one calendar.
shifts.numbers: Right now the calendar has {listings} from {organizations} in {neighborhoods}.
shifts.numbers_none: Listings appear here as soon as organizations post them.
shifts.signup: Every listing links to the organization's own sign-up page.

near_you.heading: Find one near you
near_you.body: Each listing shows its part of the city and its neighborhood.
near_you.filters: Filters help you choose a day, a time of day and a cause.

everyone.heading: Built for everyone
everyone.access: Built to work with screen readers and keyboards.

private.heading: Safe and private
private.account: You do not need an account.
private.tracking: We use no cookies and no ad tracking.
private.filters: Filters work on your own device, so your choices never reach us.
private.sensitive: Some events need extra care. We never share who might go to them, and they never appear in reports.

more.heading: More than one-off shifts
more.flexible: Flexible opportunities: programs where you choose a time with the organization.
more.teams: Volunteer Teams: activities that need a team, not one person.

rewards.heading: Coming next: Citywide Rewards
rewards.points: We plan to add points and badges for confirmed volunteer hours.
rewards.offers: We also plan offers from local businesses that volunteers can redeem.
rewards.when: We will share the details when they are ready.

why.heading: Why support it
why.residents: Residents find ways to help near them, and later a way to keep track of their hours.
why.city: More people in the city volunteer.
why.one_place: One place the City can point residents to.
why.medicaid: Help with Pennsylvania's {year} Medicaid hours rule, through our hours calculator.

support.heading: How to support
support.organizations: Organizations: tell us about your volunteer calendar so we can list your shifts. Later, you will be able to confirm volunteers' hours.
support.sponsors: Businesses and sponsors: the nonprofit that will run the site plans to offer sponsorship. Later, businesses will be able to offer volunteers coupons or event tickets.
support.office: The City of {city}: please share your volunteer programs and calendar with us, so we can list them too.
support.city: City partners: help us reach more organizations and residents.

contact.heading: Get in touch
contact.body: Ask about listing your shifts, supporting the site, or anything else.
